notes.title: Stratogun is out now!
notes.content:
[h1]STRATOGUN IS LIVE![/h1]

We're thrilled to reach launch day for Stratogun!

We want to thank everyone that has wishlisted the game, played the demo and reached out to us over social media. 

[h3]Check out the launch trailer now![/h3]
[previewyoutube=qdO3LJmYVqc;full][/previewyoutube]

We can't wait to see you all competing on the scoreboard!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo, Publisher News & VR!
notes.content:
We here at Numskull Games are so excited to finally announced that we've partnered up with Horsefly Games to publish Stratogun. 

For those who have been following the games development, we're happy to announce that Stratogun is part of the Steam Next Fest with a demo that you can download and play now.

In even more exciting news, we can now confirm that Stratogun will include VR support for the most immersive arcade experience yet.

[h1]
Watch the latest trailer to see more![/h1]

[previewyoutube=uIYrABs_OoQ;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]So what are you waiting for? Go ahead and start racking up those high scores! [/h2]


... oh, and maybe drop us a wishlist if you enjoy it!
